title: GTA 6 Official Album Announced with CD and Vinyl Pre-Orders
description: Rockstar Games has officially announced the GTA 6 album, now available for pre-order via Atlantic Records on CD and multiple vinyl editions.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Official Album Announced: CD and Vinyl Pre-Orders Live Now

As the gaming world continues to track every update surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, a new piece of the puzzle has fallen into place for music lovers. Rockstar Games has officially announced the upcoming release of the official GTA 6 album, with pre-orders now live in partnership with Atlantic Records.

### A New Soundtrack to the Criminal Underworld

The Grand Theft Auto franchise has always prided itself on legendary soundtracks, blending radio stations, licensed hits, and original compositions to define the cultural zeitgeist of its virtual worlds. With this newly announced album, several tracks have already been revealed, giving fans a preliminary taste of the auditory experience awaiting them in the game.

According to the official announcement, fans looking to own a physical piece of the experience can head over to the official site to pre-purchase the album. The physical releases cater to both traditional and collector markets, offering formats such as:

* **Standard Audio CD**: A classic option for music enthusiasts.
* **Vinyl Editions**: Available in two distinct formats, including a standard vinyl option and a specialized limited edition for serious collectors.

### Digital Pre-Saves and Streaming Availability

For those who prefer digital convenience over physical media, Rockstar Games has also made the album available for pre-saving across major streaming platforms. Fans can head to services like Apple Music, Spotify, and others to secure the album in their digital libraries ahead of its official release.

### Editor's Take

Music has always been the beating heart of the GTA experience. By launching physical CD and vinyl pre-orders alongside digital pre-saves via Atlantic Records, Rockstar is once again treating the game's audio landscape as a major cultural product in its own right. It's a must-have for collectors and audiophiles alike.
